name: Typing prompt box (one call)
description: An AI-app prompt box built by ONE agent.addPromptBox call: the box slides in from the right and widens as it lands (or pops), the prompt types in at a set length with an optional eased rate, each new character arrives in an accent colour and turns white, a blue -> pink gradient caret rides the head, and the send button is pressed (squash) with a gradient flash that wipes back from the left. Everything stays editable layers in one group. Aim cursor-click at returns.sendX / sendY on returns.pressFrame. Lighter-weight sibling of prompt-bar (which builds the bar step by step).
source: r10 S11 f426-483: dark #241e21 radius 36 box slides in (easeOutCubic 18 f), 45 chars in 25 f, pink #e780f6 -> white over 4 f, send click f462, gradient flash + wipe back f471-483
r10 S7 f227-245 light card, gradient caret, + / Attach / Themes row; r10 S4 eased typing rate

text.default: Add user authentication with login and signup

placeholder.description: Grey hint before the first keystroke ('' = none).

theme.description: dark = #241e21 box, light text (r10 S11); light = white card, dark text (r10 S7).

width.description: Box width px (default 45 % of the comp width).

fontSize.description: Text size px (default 2.8 % of the comp height: 30 px at 1080).

typeFrames.description: Typing length, frames at 30 fps (first to last character).

typeEase.description: Typing RATE ease (r10 S4: cubicInOut = slow start, fast middle).

arrival.description: New characters arrive in arrivalColor and turn to the text colour over 4 frames.

gradientCaret.description: Blue -> pink vertical gradient caret (else the text colour).

align.description: center = the typed line grows both ways.

press.description: Press send 5 frames after typing, with the gradient flash + wipe back.

args.caret: {{gradientCaret ? obj('gradient', [rgba('#6175ce'), rgba('#e85aa0')], 'width', max(3, round(FS * 0.1))) : obj('width', max(2, round(FS * 0.08)))}}

params.text: Add user authentication with login and signup
